subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-editable override contract for core prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, OpenClaw Control, and Self-Update?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety guidance and prompt precedence, while current code only supports narrower provider, hook, and bootstrap surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
options.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

options.title: Reject Core Section Overrides
options.body: Keep OpenClaw-owned sections fixed and document before_prompt_build, provider overlays, and bootstrap files as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Work
options.body: Let identity-line or config-rule work proceed independently while keeping broad Safety/template editing unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
recommendation.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, and prompt regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent provider-owned prompt contribution model and has the strongest history on the current prompt customization boundary.
